[QUERENT] Mapping Manuscript Migrations

[SYSTEM] Mapping Manuscript Migrations (MMM) is an international digital humanities project that unites disparate historical records to trace the origins, movements, provenance, and ownership history of medieval and Renaissance manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV-L1G1zWsKTcIMUl26s2CYS1WC-nLTknJcEXKGVRg3SR18sDkISCW-QchbJ6PSHqNfMF_mUwT70pfkdS5HEmYBhVOxTJ2cLfoElevHNjt9rSEAnkmA03zBz-_k4EbEI917Eky), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVhiimUeIBTse6JWvsBmsU24mXHagnL86aMRmjbyJGZCOFD7-vYmw7Ljh9-LM1mteFS0mFmQ97CFH0vmB35jt2Ad7eFpcK_bEDkjkV3eA0vq8GMSI5jwd1SotonlHnHSTgVSRLm01Qlg)]
Core Overview

* Objective & Scale: Traces the global journey of over 215,000 historical manuscripts from their creation to modern collections, enabling analysis from individual manuscript lifecycles to macro-level trade and collection trends. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAV9BINJaAaGTfKDbBNmIRJ8cjfAGJ4bc3FUVbxxVTQp1CvkYLWSjtY0RtfuBiDAACnQj_Hz5fhY9oY-qRdz_KsGbIRZA9sRcYv3ufQiSTBYFJ7ueTWnLg4HYYasLzXPI7jXDRrVacPGdIpsdyq1rBBk7Gn), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHrOzAVFVwnPxxYhckZeDS2BUD8aXaAi4K17ZolyQzC40Avsmeq-Qhd7QK4kRCYvWBp2ZxFe2hNdBaTANODbzmEc3HxYg3_DhqfmNx99Q2x6O264S_L09cnDV1aqq9htfwr3M8mVrLtnU23rpOh_w), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHrOzAVhiimUeIBTse6JWvsBmsU24mXHagnL86aMRmjbyJGZCOFD7-vYmw7Ljh9-LM1mteFS0mFmQ97CFH0vmB35jt2Ad7eFpcK_bEDkjkV3eA0vq8GMSI5jwd1SotonlHnHSTgVSRLm01Qlg)]
* Partners & Funding: A collaboration between the University of Pennsylvania, University of Oxford, Institut de recherche et d'histoire des textes (IRHT-CNRS), and Aalto University, funded by the Trans-Atlantic Platform’s Digging into Data Challenge. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVmBjuFIT9rydIIXbC770wmUabUPGoHPr4yK-vGLkAJZ06_B8qUFNMyGvUVGtvXd6fSouJbWngKjR8F0BFEmx7Ivw-39uRZy58qcy6tc8s7f7t1IC1Z6noyh70B3S4D8o), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV-L1G1zWsKTcIMUl26s2CYS1WC-nLTknJcEXKGVRg3SR18sDkISCW-QchbJ6PSHqNfMF_mUwT70pfkdS5HEmYBhVOxTJ2cLfoElevHNjt9rSEAnkmA03zBz-_k4EbEI917Eky)]

Unified Datasets & Access
The project merges records from the Schoenberg Database, Bibale, and the Medieval Manuscripts Catalogue into a Linked Open Data knowledge graph. Researchers can explore and query the data via the project's semantic portal and LDF.fi. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAV1bntwhxHmLgiJjOGUG91nhzelMj7_eAKnbQE76K5KBRHxgMPaNOF1rTN6_cW5pEuNQlCXdfKxxMWMWpS0iz8vqs2JM9ASuU_P_vRD4xRlz-Ik8LKCA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAV-L1G1zWsKTcIMUl26s2CYS1WC-nLTknJcEXKGVRg3SR18sDkISCW-QchbJ6PSHqNfMF_mUwT70pfkdS5HEmYBhVOxTJ2cLfoElevHNjt9rSEAnkmA03zBz-_k4EbEI917Eky), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVmBjuFIT9rydIIXbC770wmUabUPGoHPr4yK-vGLkAJZ06_B8qUFNMyGvUVGtvXd6fSouJbWngKjR8F0BFEmx7Ivw-39uRZy58qcy6tc8s7f7t1IC1Z6noyh70B3S4D8o), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHrOzAV9BINJaAaGTfKDbBNmIRJ8cjfAGJ4bc3FUVbxxVTQp1CvkYLWSjtY0RtfuBiDAACnQj_Hz5fhY9oY-qRdz_KsGbIRZA9sRcYv3ufQiSTBYFJ7ueTWnLg4HYYasLzXPI7jXDRrVacPGdIpsdyq1rBBk7Gn)]

[QUERENT] Schoenberg Database of Manuscripts

[SYSTEM] The [Schoenberg Database of Manuscripts](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAVesmCXyNkU-8dsk0VwPSNwcHVwnl-ZGFBUHgNuuZR3-svu7TVa-utXvqL4MWlTL1C4IUArN2TjlJ4YZ8eo4uZLccUsgR7KceUnzeSl-awda9l9w) (SDBM) is a free, open-access, crowd-sourced digital research tool hosted by the [Schoenberg Institute for Manuscript Studies](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVFcrYiHpkioIRN9Z33mmJEBFf87KerwsXaYDVHIiDAwvHUCTiybU0B7fXz0FF7Pwjv64Mw7IG3mYxRs3S8qu70LvYFrwi5qTwjWn2WUnfs681VCHQww) at Penn Libraries. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEB6zswFQ48IwKkfUtmbiudI2xAyCMNlolv_NF6zt8pU-WFiZc6ejmAg_zUXLsvSkEM97E4pPf9aJjHVEirpBjkGL0OYAk_U1q5DN3KhdPuxXReGd9HVDSnNiVuQWDOzeet93saKF5yN4Ojn6UUJUePq0HXKPuIvMVkKYQ8aGneRIOeAloWnW8gcL2L2tmm4GpiHKCbb0eyAdP7vdzh7YjoCig367wTEeV56qTBi0lMw9jAj-q1), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVDnKHE2_PSmKmAbShcSC4s7xvWcg2LuciEdu6rLpS0I3I_gnIMKNP01wcSedLvZdya8y43b15edYRH6s5jR73sVISD5JnXaoJNLVfH5synbehCa6mD7nTG5w65jtOtXVy)]
Key Features and Scope

* Purpose: Allows scholars, collectors, and researchers to trace the history and provenance of pre-modern manuscripts from their creation to the present. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAV0Mz0-mbwraqj8IKCu3RDW89bldt4esdvqrC9tJzvLlKJc_2XmTYsBP-ydn8V94FZ9NzGLnfmNjtOBNpaNqb9Jp3Gm7npaXKGdtrYVSHmbp4JLSEtdoUevd2MUE2fsG9U9uHizxCi), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEB6zswFQ48IwKkfUtmbiudI2xAyCMNlolv_NF6zt8pU-WFiZc6ejmAg_zUXLsvSkEM97E4pPf9aJjHVEirpBjkGL0OYAk_U1q5DN3KhdPuxXReGd9HVDSnNiVuQWDOzeet93saKF5yN4Ojn6UUJUePq0HXKPuIvMVkKYQ8aGneRIOeAloWnW8gcL2L2tmm4GpiHKCbb0eyAdP7vdzh7YjoCig367wTEeV56qTBi0lMw9jAj-q1)]
* Data Scale: Contains over 240,000 manuscript observation records gathered from more. than 14,000 auction catalogs, sales records, institutional inventories, and private collections. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESigEB6zswFRTCq9aBqMjttHajABGm4mJZ1KDv-LabUN2eJu173PjNUYG20fFeio_uR83Q8BeWGZxM-3DmAWgpwCfX0qUpX4-OitqDn2yekLYI395rZ7aOahAnrJpg3c3r0_CbQOFV9xP61Og1uLkLQ3w5BKGsIyryDzFw9cY3eqbvPvs5XxOmHVE-ZnY), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHrOzAVh-ADY2u7IkV-9rA5wmvgcjNOMcFahtDNr18ZbeDxX7wbOEYV1k8T_NAhBk23y75tZTEfBtDC6nY4B3amPdQMzei7WPUMAGWjGaP52eihbP4W6KVESfNVxuaX9H0Qh3nLIGWsaFGi0KJVYs-ODLA89GrX03YixgmHSA)]
* Time Period & Geography: Focuses primarily on pre-modern manuscripts dated from 500 to 1600 (though holdings span broader ranges), covering Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHrOzAVXhVfNVexyUNMK4z7KODh49BHzcF7buPnxVsaGr9m9D0zBm8rc1gAj09QLVK_Dfvqe-FUh9G9unsVMx8A_UHzt_PE8uolh-x6eWtzz7ZrrT2J4O84TneniBDEWbO6lHSQEFlJVGwbxL4vOO-jMcZ9Rf-HARD3oi29PQI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g)]
* Access & Formats: Free to use without a fee; data is searchable, browsable, and exportable in `.xlsx` and `.csv` formats. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAV3vvVKinIyL3mWdjB3ZGlYDa6hUNENyCfZ8bhG_B3spW6AkH7N0xxMWSTdqPM3REwlDvjA1Mtah-8XfpaSKzEzbZOlPeZN8fJr_1RxnZ16em8SWldqMcN6-sLi3jvgosZ7BxHN-pyRs4ifYxfjx9ZzKet6g), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHrOzAVDnKHE2_PSmKmAbShcSC4s7xvWcg2LuciEdu6rLpS0I3I_gnIMKNP01wcSedLvZdya8y43b15edYRH6s5jR73sVISD5JnXaoJNLVfH5synbehCa6mD7nTG5w65jtOtXVy)]

Core Record Structure
The database operates using five primary relational record types: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]

* Sources: Catalogs, websites, and documents that describe manuscripts. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Entries: Individual observations or listings extracted from those sources. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Manuscript Records: Centralized hubs that link multiple entries of the same physical manuscript over time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Name Authority: Index of authors, artists, owners, sellers, and institutions. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]
* Place Authority: Geographic locations tied to manuscript production, sales, or ownership. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVLV4KPyDvlLG3iOgMt7k0CXrHDubJPiwKGN_ByAle5ERN6i8FDunUtcOxdC2RWmzycU0xEtqO1xKgcXv5YPSe95OE8vkNhlSAIhxlPqW8p_wfs9U98i7fzLo99KJT09DewILvYA)]

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAV8-oe1S2woqxskKs-_qW1t8mjwzxn2U8V3fhi_dfzpGAgiehWwwuylLweVqgLbPwcD_0TZxsUeajxtJnzsjnSaJW6-8qW9dvsXlfQXoZRK-ZWzFDOJ0n0yEx6gppdPGu2LiOXM6PPUnFRggHSLmcor2Dmmp8), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAV3IeNdF7PplaQgfklaI-3p4RZ2RR_dlvZCDbDPCaMnEw1te2n_Z6UgOj04h_0GJMf8rrhSM5_ownox1khe6veMpzce0kybr3rfiOHZWXMXlGdv7CV_p-4Vpj0is0O), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFZRK-AAMChL8qoKmJUWBj-xw01VgbmeCrmUHaevJ5gHtU9CnAj3mLfIzklBpt_oI3Z982eWkq1gx07bwE4TkSl5OMuvGC2P7oKygeDo7Gw7dNMgQLmxLktTW33Y_1MaEMY_VBgOcefhueAkw_UeZvM90AbnnEJ5OgiuZPw), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEB6zswFdzEgvI8IU4FAGMtmMx-vAlgw3RnDrVpj-B9jdBgXaADZR4eIiQ9-BSMdX7BSIcJUW_aWDRn9eW1ISXqV3pZEK0MqXEDoN161nEAhggKcjeUlqVk2Fwv3pCi-1mlZF5lzqfXkLTHmVir0j1gNoSAz2-9KweFcvSWmzbrR-rsgIqXxlREeXftGBp60MtuZSDH0NDC)]
Key Features and Scope

* Core Sources: Transcriptions from archival inventories, historic auction catalogs, and art dealer stock books. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVymeS4witbwa0ffGoHGmehsmuCjn3ruUphZIgnT0RsCtwXtW-QSkeUOrmSkGE6FctF8rJD6Vl_inBePAvSmQro5m0hEbTxcom6a9PmbURaou34TSFLzr6_hGOdQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEB6zswFdzEgvI8IU4FAGMtmMx-vAlgw3RnDrVpj-B9jdBgXaADZR4eIiQ9-BSMdX7BSIcJUW_aWDRn9eW1ISXqV3pZEK0MqXEDoN161nEAhggKcjeUlqVk2Fwv3pCi-1mlZF5lzqfXkLTHmVir0j1gNoSAz2-9KweFcvSWmzbrR-rsgIqXxlREeXftGBp60MtuZSDH0NDC)]
* Specialized Collections: Includes records such as the 11 painting stock books of the New York dealership M. Knoedler & Co. and Goupil & Cie (covering 1872–1970), alongside European and American sales catalogs (dating roughly from the 16th century through the 20th century). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESegHrOzAVIXGc51NZa_ZDshHYnRG4uNk6hiHUU18ArsL_hIuqmonJFRzKf86Et7Cfx6DkMnRcxwRvJyqAUIp0LlULhLJal6qdVUDSwOfzdr8D8L-6vTDcm7zjVoijmc73qpFk5cqNzfmGjaltizoM3Cz27xU5dkln8pP4), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEB6zswFZj_uNNYjJ8CknI0F882Ug64Q0_54CeDvS37d6WQIbJFhRr1onqRd_IqOHTqTyALkzan1pa5hUBNNYyvA5u3CPUyoBfy0VvWO6dt2I758d9EPDUKTnGXo8XCOUJwUNqMXdS6gSV-tDb7xhgqglUXhYRV84IujiIuZgKTf5GgMOgdgUO2IUrGqLc2vKFwGB-lMZlOZr4X), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVymeS4witbwa0ffGoHGmehsmuCjn3ruUphZIgnT0RsCtwXtW-QSkeUOrmSkGE6FctF8rJD6Vl_inBePAvSmQro5m0hEbTxcom6a9PmbURaou34TSFLzr6_hGOdQ), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEB6zswFZRK-AAMChL8qoKmJUWBj-xw01VgbmeCrmUHaevJ5gHtU9CnAj3mLfIzklBpt_oI3Z982eWkq1gx07bwE4TkSl5OMuvGC2P7oKygeDo7Gw7dNMgQLmxLktTW33Y_1MaEMY_VBgOcefhueAkw_UeZvM90AbnnEJ5OgiuZPw)]
* Searchable Categories: People/organizations (artists, buyers, sellers, auctioneers), object types (paintings, sculptures, drawings, furniture), transaction events (sold, stolen, exchanged, given), and document/lot identifiers. [QUERENT] OLMoTrace

[SYSTEM] [OLMoTrace](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ) is an open-source system developed by the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (Ai2) that traces language model outputs back to their multi-trillion-token training datasets in real time. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWAHrOzAVIeW0Bh-S4A2VvhIfG4x5GI442H2AG7c4YT-P8qSUHih41gNA2d_u0ez62uyi0CLMCuDxp107lq0nGROUCWBCMy5JoGWd2CZ7_vNcWWCs3Lu2iFg)]
How It Works

* Real-Time Tracing: After a model generates a response in the Ai2 Playground, users can click the Show OLMoTrace button to highlight verbatim spans of text. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEB6zswFSw37mmS0ky2JdwMbluTG9bXw6YrEyY7-RDR3C6gpGJF1AjuVzgdHaMhPrwWEs6-CqOPaBUaJmKtgKhm0K6DY4dgamujc7BlSKs3Q7zgBXwn4p50GiZOmvHB7LP_ros68_TLow3I8e5BC6voQvexCU7B9RANXq30erTczX0PJp4Eoot_gOSfIdL-s64rEQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Source Retrieval: The tool matches output segments against training corpora (such as the Dolma datasets) and ranks up to 10 context documents using BM25 and unigram probabilities. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]
* Underlying Tech: It uses an extended version of infini-gram with a parallel algorithm that reduces lookup complexity to \(O(L \log N)\). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ)]

Supported Models

* OLMo 2 32B Instruct
* OLMo 2 13B Instruct
* OLMoE 1B 7B Instruct
* OLMo 3 family (including OLMo 3-Think 32B) [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVoVYHLgJxMVIjxyaZx7wDArKB6jxCb1tOprJFofLF9_o_Lr6foJNzJ2skLWhN04W7o7uFmFuQkrV4xPmu8JuLWWjcOIm7uniqJ_3AgD9QQJlTrCUJTQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAVV_6J7u0vQR70ckMfNhiCogECpGpN15fGLDhAZkGzPPDHW94cWHDI3yvNEPPIeJCWECt_JJh8NwwM53Wiwyx94U6j_n8S84uLcd-yOdbxGgO2_8_63OmgYRHsjdzAlH-iXL3LIA)]
